en.g: Talk about habits and states that are no longer true.
p: Form: used to + verb. I used to play the piano. (I don't play now.)
Negative and question: I didn't use to like coffee. Did you use to live here? No -d after did.
For one action at a time, use the past simple: I went to Paris in 2015, not I used to go once.
